Name: Achbor, Son of Michaiah
Summary: Achbor, son of Michaiah, was one of Josiah's messengers sent to inquire of Huldah concerning the found book.
KeyStory: Achbor sent to inquire of Huldah.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Hilkiah, High Priest; Michaiah, Father of Achbor; Huldah, Prophetess
LifeLesson: Inquiry is the right response to a word that condemns us.
